title: categories.names
description: Resolve category ids to display names. This object validates the request payload; the response is {"names": {"<category_id>": {"name": ..., "slug": ...}}} — see $defs.Entry. Keys are category IDS AS STRINGS (a JSON round trip must not change key types). A deleted category and an unknown id are simply absent from the mapping, mirroring the projections read() convention; an inactive category still answers (a listing can sit in a retired category and its rows still need a caption). Names are display names (the configured DISPLAY_TRANSLATOR applied), not raw translation keys.

ids.description: IDs of the categories to resolve. Capped: a suggest page needs tens of captions, and an uncapped batch is a catalogue dump through the caption endpoint.

Entry.description: One response value: the category's display name and slug.
